name: AutCore
description: AutCore is an AI-driven autism screening and risk assessment tool. The solution combines advanced oculomotor & facial behavior analysis, AI-powered speech & language disfluency analysis, intelligent autism symptom profiling & risk evaluation, and a conversational autism assistant. The team joined the hackathon 12 hours late, building the solution in just 24 hours under intense pressure.
reported_outcome: 1st Place - HackHub'25. 64% screening accuracy using gaze tracking and speech-disfluency detection.
achievements: 1st Place — HackHub'25 (IEEE CompSoc VIT-C, GitHub & Devfolio)
